secrets.name: BOT_TOKEN
secrets.description: Telegram bot token from @BotFather; required for the bot to receive messages and download media.

secrets.name: OWNER_ID
secrets.description: Numeric Telegram user ID of the primary owner (not @username); controls who sees the owner panel.

secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Server signing secret; also used to derive the Telegram webhook secret. A development placeholder was generated.
